subject: Discovery recap & three-week POC scope — next steps
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimblehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & three-week POC scope (next steps)

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into a short POC: 

Summary of pain / goals (what we heard)
- Primary pain: customer support agents spend ~45% of time triaging tickets; Nimble wants a reliable triage assistant to reduce time-to-first-response and deflect common intents.
- Secondary: strict PHI-sanitization and on-prem access required for a subset of flows.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 40% reduction in triage time on sampled queue, precision on intent classification >= 88% (macro F1 target), and end-to-end inference latency < 350ms for short requests.

Proposed three-week POC (high level)
1) Scope (weeks 0–3): deploy a dedicated POC model endpoint against a 1000-ticket seed dataset; integrate via Redwood API; run 5 prompt-eval suites (see attached prompt set).
2) Metrics / guardrails: accuracy (intent F1), latency percentiles (p50/p95), and an agent feedback pass rate. We'll instrument evaluation with Redwood Telemetry and a shared eval dashboard.
3) Owners
   - NimbleHealth: Alex (product lead) — provide sample dataset and SLA for data handoff; Priya (security) — complete onboarding checklist.
   - Redwood: Chloe — POC PM; Ben — infra & dedicated capacity; Monica — security/compliance liaison.
4) Access & setup (what we need from Nimble)
   - Share sample ticket set (anonymized) in our s3 bucket (we’ll provide path + policy).
   - A list of blocked PHI fields and any regex filters used today.
   - VPN/VPC peering request or short-lived S3 presigned access (your preference).

Attachments: 20260816-mutual-action-plan.pdf (MVP tasks and dates), prompt set v1 (attached as CSV).

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): NDA (if required) + dataset handoff + infra request
- Week 1: baseline model deploy + smoke tests
- Week 2: evaluation & prompt tuning (iterative)
- Week 3: readout + decision (go/no-go)

Next steps / asks (for Monday)
- Alex: confirm dataset drop location and whether you prefer S3 presigned or our secure upload.
- Priya: confirm any access constraints or additional paperwork (NDA/PO required).
- Ben / Monica: I’ve CC’d you for technical & security checks.

If that looks right I’ll send the mutual-action plan + a DocuSign PO/engagement stub (if you want a PO route). Happy to adjust timeline if you need more runway.

Thanks again — chloe

--
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimblehealth.com>

Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & three-week POC scope (next steps)

Chloe — this is perfect, thanks for the clear plan. A few quick items from our side:
- NDA: we have a mutual NDA in place but Priya will confirm if legal needs an addendum for the shared sample data.
- Dataset: we can upload to your s3 path. I'll get the sample dump (1,200 tickets) anonymized and drop a README with labels.
- PO / cost: can you send a high-level estimate for the three-week POC (dedicated nodes + engineering time)? If we need a PO I’ll route it.

Tentative kickoff: week of Aug 24 — if you can confirm infra needs today I’ll prioritize the data handoff.

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Rivera
VP Product, NimbleHealth
alex.rivera@nimblehealth.com | (917) 555-4422
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimblehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & three-week POC scope (next steps) — estimate & kickoff

Thanks Alex — good to hear. Quick answers: 
- Estimate (high level) for three-week POC: $9,500 (covers 2 dedicated inference workers sized for p95 <= 350ms, storage for dataset + telemetry, and a ~20 engineer-hours of onboarding/support). We can convert to PO if that helps procurement.
- Infra needs: Ben will request a dedicated pool and open ports for secure upload. Preferred data flow is S3 presigned URL (short-lived) but we can support VPC peering if Priya prefers.

I attached the prompt-set v1 (CSV) we’ll run as baseline. Once you drop data I’ll schedule our infra kick (Ben) and security onboarding (Monica).

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Aug 24 — today I can block a 30m intake to confirm exact dataset fields and labels. If Aug 24 is tight, Sep 1 is our backup kickoff.

Docs attached: 20260816-prompt-set-v1.csv (baseline prompts + eval rubric)
DocuSign PO link: https://docusign.net/ABC12345-POC
S3 share (placeholder): s3://nimblehealth-redwood-share/poc-samples/ (we’ll give presigned path once you confirm)

Let me know what works and I’ll lock the calendar.

Best — chloe
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: NimbleHealth POC — infra & security asks (owners + deadlines)

Ben / Monica — forwarding the external thread so you have context. Key asks for internal runway: 

Quoted: 
> Chloe Martin: Proposed three-week POC (high level)
> 1) Scope (weeks 0–3): deploy a dedicated POC model endpoint against a 1000-ticket seed dataset; integrate via Redwood API; run 5 prompt-eval suites.
> 2) Metrics: intent F1 >= 88%, latency p95 < 350ms.
> 3) Owners: Nimble — Alex / Priya; Redwood — Chloe (PM), Ben (infra), Monica (security).

Internal action items I need by EOD Friday (21 Aug):
- Ben: open a Dedicated request for 2 x inference workers (target p95 < 350ms) for a three-week window (start Aug 24, fallback Sep 1). Please include expected cost estimate so I can finalize the PO amount.
- Monica: stand up the security onboarding checklist for Nimble (S3 presigned vs VPC peering options + required audit artifacts). If they need an addendum for sample data, flag legal.
- Both: help confirm the limited-role API key rotation process and retention settings (we’ll default to 30-day telemetry retention unless you advise otherwise).

I’m scheduling a 30m intake with Alex on Aug 24 at 10:00am PT to confirm labels and the dataset README — I’ll send the invite once Ben confirms infra availability.

Thanks — chloe

I provisioned a short-lived presigned S3 path and RBAC token for the Nimble data drop; link and token will be created once Alex confirms. Also greenlighted p95 tuning knobs — we’ll run a small smoke-run after dataset arrival to validate 350ms target.

Ben
